The subsystem id 86751043 is an ASUS board subsystem, so the ASUS TUF series page is the most specific match if one is published.

findings.title: project_root has NO containment check before becoming a child process cwd and --add-dir grant

evidence.dead_code: host_launcher.py:484 defines _is_inside(child, parent) and its docstring says it is 'Used for the project-root binding'. A repo-wide search finds exactly ONE occurrence: the definition. There is no call site anywhere.
evidence.the_guard_that_actually_runs: host_launcher.py:760 — if not intent.project_root or not Path(intent.project_root).is_dir(): refuse with PROJECT_ROOT_MISSING. This is an EXISTENCE check only.
evidence.no_base_dir_configured: allowed_root / base_dir / workspace_root / jail / REPO_ROOT all absent from host_launcher.py
evidence.stored_verbatim: POST /api/v1/domain/projects accepted and stored '../../../../Windows/System32', '..\\..\\..\\..\\Windows\\System32', 'C:\\Windows\\System32' and '/etc/passwd' with 200 OK, no normalisation.

findings.exploitability: Requires a valid JCC_CONTROL_TOKEN, a resolvable node runtime and WorkBuddy CLI, and a signed v2 directive with a fresh launcher nonce. It is NOT reachable by an unauthenticated or remote party.
findings.honest_framing: On a single-user host where the token holder is already the operator this is a privilege-boundary defect, not a remote traversal and not a sandbox escape. It still means the launcher has no workspace boundary of its own.
findings.minimal_fix: Call the existing _is_inside at host_launcher.py just before the line 760 existence check, refusing when the root is outside a configured base directory, and add the base directory to config/jcc.yaml. This is a packages/ change and is OUTSIDE Aegis ownership.
findings.owner: main (Change Request) — packages/ is not Aegis ownership

findings.title: Non-ASCII control token raises an unhandled TypeError in the auth dependency

evidence.root_cause: require_control_token compares the presented token against JCC_CONTROL_TOKEN with hmac.compare_digest. Python's compare_digest raises TypeError('comparing strings with non-ASCII characters is not supported') for str inputs containing non-ASCII codepoints.
evidence.repro: Raw ASGI request to POST /api/pause with header x-jcc-token: \xe4\xb8\xad\xe6\x96\x87 → the app raised TypeError out of the dependency. Verified by driving the ASGI app directly, because httpx refuses to encode a non-ASCII header (UnicodeEncodeError) and would otherwise mask it.
evidence.security_impact: NONE on confidentiality or integrity. The request is still refused; no token is ever accepted that should not be. This is an availability/robustness defect: an unhandled exception instead of a 403, which also crashes the request rather than logging a clean denial.

findings.minimal_fix: Encode both operands to bytes with errors handling, or wrap the compare in try/except TypeError and fall through to 403.
findings.owner: main (Change Request) — packages/ is not Aegis ownership

findings.title: D:\\jev\\.env declares JCC_CONTROL_TOKEN, JCC_CONFIG and JEV_API_KEY with EMPTY values, and the host exports no JCC_*/JEV_* variables at all

evidence.process_env: Get-ChildItem Env: filtered to ^JCC_|^JEV_|^HERMES returned NOTHING. No JCC_* or JEV_* variable is exported in this session.
evidence.note: No secret VALUE was read into this artifact. Only names, emptiness and lengths were recorded.

findings.security_impact: This is SAFE by design rather than broken: control_token reads os.environ.get(env_name), so an unset or empty token yields '' which require_control_token rejects, i.e. the control plane is LOCKED, not open. The measured 27 mutating routes all refused. The risk is operational: an operator could believe a token is configured when the file says otherwise, and JEV_API_KEY being empty means the real provider cannot authenticate.
findings.minimal_fix: Document that a committed .env with empty values is a fail-closed placeholder, and make the health endpoint report control_token_configured=false so it is visible without leaking anything.
findings.owner: main (Change Request) — packages/ and config/ are not Aegis ownership

findings.title: SessionIsolation map in the webhook receiver grows without bound

evidence.unbounded: SessionIsolation._map has NO eviction, NO TTL and NO maxsize. In the probe, 3000 distinct signed session_ids left isolation_map_size=0 because the probe used verify() directly; through handle() each distinct session_id binds permanently for the process lifetime.

findings.security_impact: Memory growth on a long-lived receiver, and the isolation map itself is a cross-agent binding table an attacker with the webhook secret could deliberately grow. Requires the shared secret, so it is post-authentication.
findings.minimal_fix: Give SessionIsolation the same TTL + maxsize treatment as ReplayCache, or derive bindings from the audit table.

findings.title: CLAIM FALSIFIED: SOFTWARE_RENDERER_TOKENS does already cover 'Microsoft Basic Render Driver'

evidence.actual_tuple_in_tree: ('swiftshader','subzero','llvmpipe','softpipe','software','basic render driver','basic display adapter','warp','microsoft basic','mesa offscreen')
evidence.line_numbers: tools/v1_3_wave10_browser_perf.py:181-186 (the tuple spans 181 to 186, it is not a 2-line tuple ending at 182)
evidence.executed_proof: Imported the real module and called the real classify_renderer(). 'ANGLE (Microsoft, Microsoft Basic Render Driver (0x0000008C) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)' -> SOFTWARE. 'ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti ...)' -> HARDWARE. '' -> UNKNOWN. 'Some Future Unrecognised Renderer v1' -> UNKNOWN.
evidence.the_defence_is_better_than_the_claim_ass: classify_renderer has a THIRD branch that returns UNKNOWN. 'Not obviously software' never folds into HARDWARE, so an unrecognised future renderer cannot be quietly reported as a GPU either.
evidence.provenance: The docstring records that this exact defect WAS observed on this host on 2026-09-30 (after the 11:22:58 reboot left the adapter at PnP code 52) and was already fixed. The stale premise appears to predate that fix.

findings.conclusion: No product honesty defect. No change request needed. No Harbor ticket needed. Anyone re-raising this must run the classifier first, not read the token tuple from memory.
